Hero is now Small Prophets — 4 of 6 episodes are out, finale Wed Nov 4. Slow Horses S6 finished Wed Oct 21 and is binge-ready. Futurama S14 ended Sep 28 and you rated it, so it leaves active recs; Hulu ordered three XXXL specials instead of a Season 15, the first due in 2027. Corrections vs. the Sep 28 file: Barbarian was recommended although you rated it 4★ in March (removed); American Classic is on the MGM+ add-on channel, not Prime Video itself (removed); Hereditary landed on Hulu Oct 1, not Oct 3; Signal One is flagged as leaving Hulu ~Nov 1 (dropped); Slow Horses S6 settled at 98% RT. Promoted from upcoming now that they're live: Small Prophets (hero), Carrie, Helluva Boss S3, The Diplomat S4, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 and Where's Wanda? S2; The Terminal List S2, Firefly Wedding and Ranma ½ S3 went to the bench. Last-chance flag: Bridesmaids (JustWatch shows the Prime offer itself ending ~Oct 31). Good Fortune's 'leaving' label turned out to sit on an Amazon rental offer, so it stays on Prime and moves to the bench. An adversarial re-check of all 18 default-page cards confirmed 16 as-is and corrected those two details. Watchlist: the nine already-watched pins were cleared on Oct 24; only Vox Machina S4 remains pinned. New to the active list: Phony, The Lowdown S2, Nocturne (premieres Fri), Companion, Hokum, Haunted Hotel S2, Taskmaster S22 and Bridesmaids (last chance on Prime). Moved to the bench, still verified: Last Seen, Brothers, JoJo and Scrubs, plus new catalog depth (What We Do in the Shadows, Dandadan, Pluribus, Russian Doll, Derry Girls, Arcane, Hit Man, Wake Up Dead Man, Usher, Weapons, Below, FROM, VisionQuest, Wayne, Nobody Wants This S3, Lupin Part 4, Save Yourselves!). Fauda S5 dropped from the bench as a poor taste fit. Upcoming adds: Dead-End Job (Fri), Black Bag on Hulu (Nov 2), Bass X Machina (Nov 3), Stick S2 (Nov 4), Black Doves S2 (Nov 5), Rings of Power S3 and Rivals S2 Part 2 (Nov 11), Mickey 17 on Hulu (Nov 23), Blade Runner 2099 (Nov 25), Bad Monkey S2 (Dec 2) and Neuromancer (Jan 22, 2027). Loved-list re-check: no new dates for Foundation S4, Severance S3, Black Mirror S8, Rick and Morty S10, TLOU S3 or Slow Horses S7; Gen V S3 was cancelled.

hero.title: Small Prophets S1 — Ep 5 'Who's Gonna Make Me Laugh?' (Wed Oct 28)
hero.date: Wed Oct 28, 2026 — weekly Wednesdays; 4 of 6 eps live since the two-ep premiere Wed Oct 7; finale Ep 6 'The Wise Man's Song' Wed Nov 4
hero.about: Mackenzie Crook (Detectorists) writes, directs and co-stars. Michael Sleep, a Manchester DIY-store worker whose partner vanished seven years ago, is handed an old recipe by his father (Michael Palin) and starts growing homunculi — tiny beings that foretell the future. Four episodes are banked; Ep 5 lands Wednesday.
hero.why: Built for you: dry British humour, a supernatural premise, a missing-person mystery and 29-minute episodes, from the Detectorists creator with Michael Palin. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (23 reviews), Metascore 87. Four episodes are banked — under two hours — so one evening gets you current before Wednesday's Ep 5 and the Nov 4 finale.

new_this_week.title: The Lowdown S2 — Ep 4 'Raw Milk' (Wed Oct 28)

From Reservation Dogs creator Sterlin Harjo.

new_this_week.title: Dark Matter S2 — Ep 10 'No Quiet Life', Season Finale (Fri Oct 30)

new_this_week.title: Nocturne — Series Premiere, Eps 1–2 (Fri Oct 30)
new_this_week.date: Fri Oct 30, 2026 — two-episode premiere, then weekly Fridays (Ep 3 'Eyes on the Inside' Fri Nov 6) through the Ep 10 finale Fri Dec 25 (Apple TV press, Deadline, TVLine)

Zazie Beetz plays an FBI agent close to Jonah. Adapted from Lars Kepler's Joona Linna novels.
new_this_week.why: A prestige Apple book adaptation with a heavyweight cast in your suspense lane, built as a cat-and-mouse with twists. Dark with no comic relief and no reviews yet — check the Tomatometer after Friday before committing.

new_this_week.about: Adult-animated horror-comedy: single mom Katherine inherits her late brother's hotel and moves her kids in alongside his good-natured ghost and a roster of high-maintenance supernatural guests — ghosts, a demon named Abaddon, a witch — who never check out. Will Forte, Eliza Coupe and Jimmi Simpson lead the voice cast.

new_this_week.title: Companion — New on Hulu
new_this_week.date: Added to Hulu Sun Oct 18, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Oct 24)
new_this_week.about: A weekend getaway at a remote lake house turns deadly once it's revealed that Iris (Sophie Thatcher), Josh's sweet girlfriend, is a companion robot — and she starts asking what she was built for. Jack Quaid, Harvey Guillén and Rupert Friend co-star; written and directed by Drew Hancock.

new_this_week.title: Hokum — New on Hulu
new_this_week.date: Added to Hulu Sat Oct 10, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Oct 24)
new_this_week.about: Horror novelist Ohm Bauman (Adam Scott) travels to a remote Irish inn where his parents honeymooned to scatter their ashes. The honeymoon suite is said to be haunted by a witch, and when a staff member disappears he is pulled into nightmarish visions of his own past. From Damian McCarthy (Oddity).
new_this_week.why: Severance's Adam Scott in a folk-horror mystery with well-timed shocks — supernatural, twisty and a tidy 107 minutes for Halloween week. 90% on Rotten Tomatoes (209 reviews, Certified Fresh), Metascore 76.

new_this_week.title: Carrie — Full Season Live (Mike Flanagan)
new_this_week.date: Wed Oct 7, 2026 — all 8 eps dropped at once
new_this_week.about: Mike Flanagan reimagines Stephen King's debut: Carrie White, homeschooled in seclusion by her religious-extremist mother, is forced into public high school, where phone-amplified bullying collides with the telekinetic power she is only beginning to understand. Summer H. Howell and Samantha Sloyan lead.
new_this_week.why: Halloween-week pick: horror/suspense, a novel adaptation and supernatural themes, with critics singling out the acting. 85% on Rotten Tomatoes (133 reviews), Metascore 71. Flanagan's slow-burn dread — give it two episodes.

new_this_week.why: Your #1 genre with dense world-building and a mystery critics say pays off in the final act. 80% on Rotten Tomatoes (10 reviews), MAL 8.27. Two or three 28-minute episodes a night finishes it in a week.

Keri Russell, Rufus Sewell, Allison Janney, Bradley Whitford.

bench.date: Added to Netflix Sat Oct 10, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Oct 24)

bench.title: Wayne S1 — New on Netflix (Complete Series)

bench.why: Sarcastic dark comedy with real heart in 33-minute episodes. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (13 reviews), 95% audience. One season only — it was cancelled — but reviews call the ending satisfying.

bench.title: Nobody Wants This S3 — Full Season Live
bench.date: Thu Oct 22, 2026 — all 10 eps dropped at once; S1–S2 (20 eps) also on Netflix

bench.why: Fast banter and a sharp ensemble in 27-minute episodes. 87% on Rotten Tomatoes (15 reviews), Metascore 75. Romance-forward rather than your core genres, and you'd be starting from S1 (30 eps total), so a 'try'.

bench.title: Lupin Part 4 — Full Season Live
bench.date: Fri Oct 23, 2026 — all 8 eps dropped at once; Parts 1–3 (17 eps) also on Netflix
bench.about: Gentleman thief Assane Diop (Omar Sy) is serving his sentence when a copycat 'Lupin' announces simultaneous museum heists across Paris and frames him — so he breaks out to take up the persona one more time. Inspired by Maurice Leblanc's Arsène Lupin novels; French with an English dub.
bench.why: Twists that pay off and pure escapism; the series holds 98% on Rotten Tomatoes and Part 4 is 100% on early reviews (Metascore 78). Part 4 picks up straight from Part 3's ending, so it's a from-the-top commitment if you haven't started.

bench.title: Rooster Fighter S1 — New on Netflix
bench.date: Added to Netflix Sat Oct 10, 2026 — all 12 eps (also on Hulu)
bench.about: Towering demons called Kiju invade Japan, and the last line of defense is Keiji — a lone rooster with razor-sharp spurs hunting the White Demon that killed his sister. A straight-faced, gory action parody.
bench.why: Absurdist premise played completely deadpan, demon mythology, 24-minute episodes. Reviews are thin (IMDb 7.0), so sample one episode before committing.

bench.title: Good Fortune — On Prime Video
bench.date: Included with Prime since Aug 21, 2026 (JustWatch-verified Oct 24; no end date on the Prime offer)
bench.about: Aziz Ansari's directorial debut: Gabriel (Keanu Reeves), a low-ranking guardian angel whose actual job is stopping people from texting while driving, swaps broke gig worker Arj (Ansari) into the life of a rich tech guy (Seth Rogen) to teach him a lesson. Keke Palmer and Sandra Oh round out the cast.
bench.why: Off-beat humor, a heaven-bureaucracy premise that is the closest film cousin to Good Omens, and an ensemble cast. 79% on Rotten Tomatoes (150 reviews), 80% audience.

bench.title: VisionQuest — Eps 5–6 (Tue Oct 27)
bench.date: Tue Oct 27, 2026 (6pm PT) on Disney+ — weekly; Eps 1–4 live; Ep 7 Tue Nov 3, finale Ep 8 'Forever' Tue Nov 10 (Disney+'s own article lists the following Wednesdays, so check Wednesday if Tuesday comes up empty)
bench.about: The final part of the WandaVision trilogy: Paul Bettany's White Vision, carrying the original Vision's memories, goes on the run with Wanda's son Tommy while a killer called the Butcherbird hunts them — and inside his mind, Ultron (James Spader) and a crew of retired Stark AIs fight for control. From Terry Matalas (Star Trek: Picard S3).
bench.why: Sci-fi world-building with a mystery engine and Diane Morgan's dry humour among the AIs. 90% on Rotten Tomatoes (79 reviews) but Metascore 64; best if you've seen WandaVision.

bench.title: Weapons — On Prime Video
bench.date: Included with Prime since Mar 2026 (JustWatch-verified Oct 24) — no leaving date on the Prime offer
bench.about: At 2:17 a.m., seventeen children from one third-grade class get out of bed, run into the dark and vanish. Zach Cregger's follow-up to Barbarian tells the town's search in chapters — the suspected teacher (Julia Garner), a grieving father (Josh Brolin), a cop.
bench.why: The same formula as Barbarian, which you rated 4★ — suspense, twists and dark humour, with an occult payoff. 93% on Rotten Tomatoes (400 reviews), Metascore 81. Runs 2h 9m.

bench.title: Below — 6-Ep Limited Series
bench.date: Live since Thu Oct 8, 2026 — all 6 eps out
bench.about: In a Newfoundland fishing town, a stubborn fisherman (Josh Hartnett) still haunted by his father's mysterious death has to hold his family and community together when an unidentified giant sea creature starts attacking. Mackenzie Davis and Charlie Heaton co-star.
bench.why: Jaws-style creature suspense in six 40-minute episodes. Critics give it 88% (50 reviews) but audiences only 51%, citing an uneven back half — a 'try'.

bench.title: What We Do in the Shadows — Complete Series on Hulu
bench.date: All 6 seasons (61 eps) on Hulu — JustWatch-verified Oct 24
bench.about: Mockumentary about four centuries-old vampire roommates — one an 'energy vampire' who bores people to death — and their long-suffering human familiar, fumbling through modern life on Staten Island. Developed by Jemaine Clement from his and Taika Waititi's film.
bench.why: Dark supernatural comedy, deadpan absurdist humour, 25-minute episodes and a great ensemble — about as close to a sure thing as the catalog gets. 96% on Rotten Tomatoes (222 reviews).

bench.title: Dandadan S1–S2
bench.date: Both seasons (24 eps) on Crunchyroll and Netflix — JustWatch-verified Oct 24; Season 3 due 2027
bench.about: A girl who believes in ghosts and an occult-obsessed classmate who believes in aliens dare each other to prove it — and both turn out to be right. A chaotic mix of yokai, UFOs, awkward teen romance and gonzo action-comedy from Science SARU.
bench.why: Supernatural plus sci-fi, fast off-beat comedy and Demon Slayer-level action animation in 24-minute episodes. 100% on Rotten Tomatoes (25 reviews). Expect some crude running gags.

bench.title: Pluribus S1 — On Apple TV+
bench.date: All 9 eps on Apple TV+ (aired Nov–Dec 2025); Season 2 ordered, no date
bench.about: In Albuquerque, a cranky romance novelist (Rhea Seehorn) is one of the few people left unaffected when a mysterious event turns the rest of humanity into a blissfully content collective — and she may be the only one who wants to undo it. From Vince Gilligan.
bench.why: High-concept sci-fi with a sardonic lead and mystery twists, in the Severance vein you love. 99% on Rotten Tomatoes (123 reviews), Metascore 87 — a deliberate slow burn, and audiences are split.

bench.title: Russian Doll S1–S2 — On Netflix
bench.date: Both seasons (15 eps) on Netflix — JustWatch-verified Oct 24
bench.about: A sardonic New York game developer (Natasha Lyonne) keeps dying on the night of her 36th birthday party and waking up at the start of the same evening. Season 2 moves the puzzle to time travel through the subway.
bench.why: Dark humour plus sci-fi, a quick-witted lead and a puzzle box that pays off, in 28-minute episodes. 97% on Rotten Tomatoes (166 reviews). Season 2 gets more abstract.

bench.title: Daemons of the Shadow Realm S1 — Complete
bench.date: All 24 eps on Crunchyroll (aired Apr–Sep 2026); also on Netflix and Hulu; Season 2 announced, no date
bench.about: Yuru, a young hunter from a remote mountain village, watches outsiders attack his home — and one of them looks exactly like his sister Asa. Bonded to two powerful daemons, he heads into the outside world to learn which Asa is real. From Fullmetal Alchemist creator Hiromu Arakawa; animated by Bones.
bench.why: Fantasy mythology with a mystery hook and humour balancing the action, in 23-minute episodes — the supernatural action-fantasy pocket Demon Slayer fills. No critic consensus yet (IMDb 7.7).

bench.date: On Netflix since Dec 12, 2025 (JustWatch-verified Oct 24)
